scale_invariant_canonicalization_candida.reason_for_amendment: Reduced-space diagonal equilibration is not invariant because an original-column rescaling changes the orthonormal null-space basis by a generally non-diagonal coordinate transformation.
scale_invariant_canonicalization_candida.reduced_matrix: Q_transpose_Z_transpose_W_Z_Q where Q is an orthonormal basis of null(C_canonical)
scale_invariant_canonicalization_candida.invariance_proof: For any positive diagonal reparameterization T, X_new=X*T, C_new=C*T, and S_new=S*T, so X_new*S_new_inverse=X*S_inverse and C_new*S_new_inverse=C*S_inverse.
adoption_requires: model invariants pass for all c multipliers
canonical condition is invariant to the c probe within 1e-10 relative error
full history uses the same deterministic transformation
